fato_historico: 1972: American pay television network Home Box Office (HBO) launches.

frase_do_dia: Your inner light is the most captivating story you will ever share with others.
significado_numero: A master builder number representing harmony and the manifestation of dreams.
conselho: Trust your gut feelings and let your authentic self shine brightly today.
